title: Model a relationship and its reverse lookup
description: Store an author relationship on posts and expose the author's posts through a virtual join field.
problem: One record should point to another record, and you also want the reverse view without storing duplicate data.
summary: Store the owning relationship on one side and use a join field for the reverse lookup when you need one-to-many content structures.
runtimeNotes: Pure schema relationship pattern with no runtime-specific behavior.
intents: show every post written by a user
